parameters.content:
## SEO Agent — API front door
`POST /webhook/seo-keyword-check` (header auth: credential **SEO API Key**, header `X-API-Key`).

Body: `mode` (keyword | verdict | audit | discover | describe), `keyword`, `country` (name or ISO-2), `domain`, `business`, `customers`, `page_type`, `competitors`, `email`, `callback_url` (https).

Answers **202** `{status:'accepted', request_id, …}` at once and starts **SEO Agent v4** in the background (Execute Workflow, no wait). The finished result (verdict, keyword data, PDF + Word file as base64, run_ledger) is POSTed to `callback_url` with the same `request_id`, and/or emailed. Malformed requests get **400**; requests rejected later in the main run are POSTed as `{status:'rejected'}`.

Why separate: n8n rejects Respond-to-Webhook nodes downstream of a Form Trigger, and the main workflow is form-driven.
